subject: Mutual action plan + acceptance suite for Crestline pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Li <anna@crestlinehealth.com>, procurement@crestlinehealth.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan + acceptance suite for Crestline pilot

Hi Anna / Crestline procurement team,

Thanks again for the time last week — great alignment on scope. Attached is a first-draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a compact acceptance-test suite that maps to the MAP milestones. The goal here is to make the pilot’s success criteria and go/no-go checks explicit so we can avoid last-minute surprises during procurement and security review.

High-level ask: please review and confirm (a) the acceptance gates below, (b) any additional data-procurement constraints, and (c) that the target close timeline (pilot sign-off week of 2026-07-06) still works on your side.

Summary of key acceptance gates (see attached worksheet for the full timeline):
- Gate A — Connectivity & onboarding: Redwood private endpoint reachable in your VPC or through secure peering; sample dataset ingestion of 10k rows completed. Test: successful model inference on sample dataset with expected schema.
- Gate B — Privacy & Data Handling: Confirm data retention window and encryption-at-rest policy; run sample redaction test to validate PII masking in responses. Test: no PII in stored logs, verified by our script.
- Gate C — Latency & Throughput: 95th percentile latency <= 400ms for the 1k token canonical prompt set; throughput target 20 qps for burst testing. Test: run the attached load script and upload results to the Drive folder.
- Gate D — Quality & Regression: Top-line quality checks on hallucination rate on the 200-case prompt set; automatic rollback on a 15% regression vs baseline. Test: pass the acceptance-tests.yml harness.
- Gate E — Security & Compliance: SOC 2 evidence upload, access control review, and one security interview with Crestline infosec.

Attachments: Crestline-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP milestones + owners), crestline-acceptance-tests.yml (test harness).

Next steps I propose:
1) Crestline: confirm any additional acceptance gates by 2026-06-18.
2) Redwood: provide SOC 2 report and finalize the test harness by 2026-06-17.
3) Schedule the pilot cutover demo week of 2026-06-29 for live run and performance verification.

If that timeline looks tight, tell us which milestone(s) to shift — we can compress the test window but will need firm access to the sample dataset to do so.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Crestline-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), crestline-acceptance-tests.yml (yaml test harness)
From: Anna Li <anna@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@crestlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + acceptance suite for Crestline pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for this — the MAP spreadsheet is helpful. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we mark Gate B and E as ready:
1) Data retention window: we cannot retain any raw PHI beyond 90 days in vendor storage. Will Redwood support automatic purge and can you confirm what is persisted for debugging (full responses vs. metadata only)?
2) SOC 2: can you provide the most recent report and a contact for your security lead? Our procurement/legal team will want to attach it to the SOW.
3) For Gate C latency: Crestline’s real-world prompts skew longer than your canonical 1k token case — can we run a targeted 200-sample test with our longer prompts during the demo week?

Procurement: please confirm whether Crestline is comfortable with the target pilot sign-off week of 2026-07-06 or if we need to extend.

Thanks,
Anna Li
Head of Digital Experience
Crestline Health

Hi Anna / team,

Quick answers to Anna’s points:
- Retention: Redwood can enforce an automatic purge of raw inputs/responses after 90 days. By default our hosted logs keep request/response metadata (timestamps, token counts, model id) for 180 days; we can scope Crestline to metadata-only retention per the SOW.
- Debugging artifacts: we keep anonymized traces and sampling flags; full responses are optional and only retained if you opt-in for debugging. We will document what is retained in the MAP (see updated tab).
- SOC 2: attaching the latest report in my reply (SOC2-Report-Redwood-2026.pdf). Our security lead is Irene Choi (irene.choi@redwoodinference.com) — happy to set up a 30-min call with your infosec.
- Latency tests: the demo week can include your 200-sample long-prompt set. Our suggestion: run one cold run and two warm runs to exercise KV cache behavior — we’ll provide a load script and expected SLA metrics.

Operational note: for Gate C we recommend the following pass/fail thresholds during pilot run: 95p latency <= 450ms for long prompt set, average throughput >= 15 qps during the 5-minute burst window. If these are acceptable, we’ll update the MAP and the acceptance-tests.yml accordingly.

Attaching: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2026.pdf.

-Karthik
Director, Product & Performance
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + acceptance suite for Crestline pilot — timeline confirmation

Anna / procurement team — thanks for the quick feedback and for raising the retention constraint. We updated the MAP spreadsheet (new tab: data-retention) and adjusted Gate C thresholds to the long-prompt targets Karthik suggested.

Concretely:
- We will configure Crestline’s tenant to purge raw inputs/responses at 90 days and persist metadata-only for 180 days (documented in the MAP).
- Security: Irene will join a 30-minute call next week with your infosec. I’ve copied Sean to start scheduling.
- Testing: we’ve scheduled the demo/pilot verification week for 2026-06-29 — live run + long-prompt 200-sample test on Tue 2026-06-30 at 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm availability.
- Target close: assuming the demo run passes the acceptance-tests.yml (no more than one critical regression and latency within updated thresholds), Crestline sign-off target is 2026-07-06. If any Gate D regressions occur we’ll coordinate a remediation sprint with your team (target rollback or patch within 5 business days).

Attachments & links: I uploaded an updated MAP and the acceptance harness to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-crestline-pilot. Also attached a printable acceptance checklist for procurement.

If this looks good I’ll ask procurement to start the SOW redline phase and I’ll send a calendar invite for the security interview.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
